title: Авиатека / Aviateka: open library of design tools for flying craft of every kind
description: Curated bilingual (RU/EN) catalog of open design tools for aircraft and rotorcraft, fabric craft and balloons, airships, seaplanes, WIG and hydrofoil craft, high-speed and entry vehicles, civil rockets, with a craft classifier, workflows, gaps, a validation matrix, calculators and an MCP server.
